title: Commercial Banking Product Strategist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Codat
description_html:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a deeply experienced commercial banking practitioner to join Codat as we build the Advisory Intelligence layer for commercial banking. You will be the voice of the banker inside our product organization — the person who knows, from years of first-hand experience, how relationship managers and treasury officers actually serve their clients, where the revenue lives in a commercial banking book, and what an insight has to look like before a banker will act on it. This is a product subject matter expert role first and foremost: you will shape the data and insights modules that Codat's Banking Context Engine generates for banker users. You will use these expertise in front of prospects and customers, working alongside our GTM team in conversations with some of the largest commercial banks in North America and the UK.

The Role
This role sits at a unique intersection between Product, GTM and strategy covering the following broad intersection.

  • Design actionable insights: Work hand in hand with Product Managers to deliver the substance of the insight modules our Banking Context Engine delivers — defining what signals matter across Treasury & Payments, FX, supply chain finance, working capital and lending, what a banker needs to see to act, and what "actionable" genuinely means in the context of a client conversation. You'll separate insights that generate fee revenue and deepen relationships from noise that erodes banker trust.

  • Be the voice of the banker: Bring the daily reality of commercial bankers and treasury management officers into every product decision — coverage models, portfolio reviews, pre-call preparation, annual pricing conversations, cross-sell motions — so that what we build fits how banks actually work rather than how outsiders imagine they work.

  • Consult into the product build: Actively collaborate with our product and engineering teams as they build the Banking Context Engine and its MCP integration with Microsoft Copilot, translating banking domain knowledge into concrete requirements, evaluation criteria, and quality bars for generated insights.

  • Support GTM as the banking SME: Join sales conversations, demos, and executive meetings with prospect and customer banks as the credible domain expert in the room. Support discovery by speaking the language of bank product heads, treasury management leaders and commercial banking executives, and help our GTM team pressure-test messaging against how banks really buy.

  • Sharpen how banks measure value: Help build the ROI narratives that connect Codat's insights to outcomes banks care about — fee revenue growth from the existing book, expanded coverage without added headcount, and client retention against fintech encroachment.

  • Build institutional knowledge: Codify what you know — banker workflows, product economics, org structures, buying dynamics — into reusable assets that raise the banking fluency of the whole company.

What you'll bring to the team

  • Substantial first-hand experience inside commercial banking — as a treasury management officer or sales/product lead, commercial relationship manager, or commercial product manager serving mid-market and SMB clients

  • A working command of how commercial banks make money from operating relationships: treasury and payments fee structures, deposit economics, FX, card, supply chain finance and working capital products, and how these are priced, bundled and cross-sold

  • Deep familiarity with how banks organize coverage — RM and TMO territory models, portfolio segmentation, call planning, and the practical constraints that determine whether a client gets proactive advice or none at all

  • The ability to translate domain expertise into product requirements: you can tell a product team precisely why an insight will or won't land with a banker, and articulate what would change that

  • Credibility and composure in front of senior bank executives — you have sat across from (or been) the heads of treasury management, commercial banking or product at a significant institution, and can hold that room

  • Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted banking workflows — familiarity with copilot-style tools (e.g. Microsoft Copilot) and an informed point of view on where AI genuinely helps bankers.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving scale-up with significant opportunity to influence our future success

title: Director, Technical Product Marketing
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Radiant
description_html:
About the Role

Location: London / London-adjacent, with regular time expected in our London and/or Gloucester offices

Function: Marketing

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

About the Role

Radiant is looking for a Director of Technical Product Marketing to turn our technical advantages into clear, credible, market-facing narratives.

This is an embedded, hands-on role focused on the end-to-end datacenters we build. You will work with infrastructure, product, engineering, solutions, partnerships, and leadership to understand our architecture and explain its value to hyperscaler customers and other technical and business audiences.

Our audience is focused and well understood. Your priority is technical product understanding and original storytelling, with ownership beyond launch checklists, personas, sales decks, or technical documentation. The right candidate will be technically curious, commercially sharp, and an exceptional writer. The successful candidate will be deeply technical in the area of data centers/AI factories and AI infrastructure.

What You'll Own

Technical Product Narrative

  • Own Radiant's technical product narrative across our platform, infrastructure, and market-facing offerings.

  • Work with product and engineering to develop positioning, messaging, and product explanations for customers, partners, analysts, executives, and the broader market.

  • Explain why we built the technology this way, what breaks at scale, which tradeoffs matter, and what differentiates us. Connect each claim to evidence and a reason for technical buyers to care.

Technical Content and Web Copy

  • Write technical blogs, product and solution pages, whitepapers, reference architecture content, case studies, customer stories, launch narratives, technical explainers, executive essays, and long-form thought leadership.

  • Adapt the level of detail for technical buyers, business decision-makers, partners, investors, and industry observers without losing accuracy.

  • Work with design, web, product, and marketing teams to make pages clear, technically grounded, and commercially useful.

Speaking and Executive Communications

  • Develop the thesis, architecture explanations, proof points, technical arguments, and story arcs behind talks, panels, submissions, keynotes, podcasts, and executive posts.

  • The social and communications team may own the opportunity pipeline and distribution cadence. Your role provides the technical substance.

  • Ghostwrite corporate and executive content that requires technical depth, product understanding, or strategic market framing.

  • This is a public-facing role requiring excellent communication.

Customer Stories and Proof Points

  • Build Radiant's library of customer, partner, and product proof with sales, solutions, customer teams, and leadership.

  • Capture the original problem, what was deployed, what was difficult, and what changed. Turn the technical and business impact into evidence customers can evaluate and sales can use.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you will have built strong working relationships with product and engineering, developed a clear understanding of Radiant's technical architecture and product priorities, and shipped a meaningful set of market-facing assets.

You will have created a repeatable process for extracting technical stories from the organization and turning them into blogs, web copy, technical narratives, executive content, speaking inputs, and longer-form assets.

Over time, success means Radiant has a deeper, sharper, more technically credible voice in the market. The website explains the product more clearly, our blogs are technical and differentiated.

Who You Are

  • You have 8 - 12+ years of experience in technical product marketing, product marketing, technical content, developer marketing, infrastructure marketing, solutions marketing, or a closely related role.

  • You bring deep technical expertise in datacenters, AI factories, and AI infrastructure, with a background in cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data infrastructure, datacenters, or high-performance computing. A technical degree is preferred.

  • You are an excellent writer with experience explaining complex technical topics to external audiences. You produce accurate, compelling content with minimal handholding and edit out hype, unnecessary complexity, and generic claims.

  • You work confidently with product managers, engineers, architects, and technical executives. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must understand complex systems, ask precise questions, and identify what matters.

  • You have strong product judgment: distinguish features from benefits, claims from proof, capabilities from differentiation, and market trends from useful points of view.

  • You work autonomously: find the right experts, ask questions, create drafts, pressure-test claims, and move work through to publication.

  • You are commercially aware, creating content that helps customers evaluate the product, equips sales and executives to explain its value, and builds credibility.

Relevant settings include high-growth B2B technology companies, AI infrastructure companies, cloud platforms, data infrastructure companies, telecom infrastructure businesses, semiconductor ecosystems, and technical agencies with deep infrastructure experience.

Ideal Background

The strongest candidates may come from high-growth B2B technology companies, AI infrastructure companies, cloud platforms, developer tools companies, cybersecurity companies, data infrastructure companies, telecom infrastructure businesses, semiconductor ecosystems, or technical agencies with deep infrastructure experience.

Experience working with engineers, architects, product leaders, founders, or technical executives is strongly preferred.

Experience writing about complex technical topics for external audiences is required.

Experience with AI, GPUs, Kubernetes, networking, datacenter infrastructure, cloud platforms, MLOps, sovereign AI, or enterprise infrastructure is a major plus.

Why should you join us?

 

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

 

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging

We are an equal opportunity employer and we strive to reduce unconscious bias throughout our hiring process. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity status or disability status. To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make.

description_html:
We're building the world's fastest way to design real, functional 3D parts. Kyrall's AI-powered design agent turns ideas into ready-to-manufacture 3D models in seconds.
Backed by top European VCs, we're a young, well-funded startup based in Munich and we're just getting started.

The Role

As a Machine learning Engineer specialized in 3D geometry, you'll develop models that understand, manipulate, and generate CAD parts. You'll work on challenging problems involving 3D representations, geometric relationships and manufacturability.

What To Expect

  • Build and optimize ML models for 3D shape understanding and generation

  • Design data pipelines that process CAD formats into ML-compatible representations

  • Implement efficient training workflows for geometric deep learning

  • Deploy models to production and optimize for performance

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to integrate ML capabilities

  • 2+ Years of working ML experience

  • Strong knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow

  • Experience with 3D data representation (B-Reps, point clouds, meshes, voxels, implicit surfaces)

  • Proficiency in Python and ML engineering best practices

  • Proven track record of bringing ML models to production

Nice To Have

  • Experience with CAD/3D software/libraries

  • Knowledge of computational geometry algorithms

  • Experience with MLOps tools and practices

Why Kyrall?

We're reinventing how machines are designed and built, from the ground up.

Our mission: build the world's first truly functional hardware design agent. 3D modeling tools were the last major leap in this space, but the way we design parts today has hit its limit. It's time for something radically better, and we're at the start of it.

As one of our first hires, you won't just execute the vision, you'll help shape it, with a competitive salary and stock options to match.

Market and strategic feedback

We're excited about you because

Strong plus

What you'll get

description_html:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich, the role will be based remotely or hybrid from Germany or Austria. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by blp.

 

About the role

As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you'll operate at the intersection of business and tech, leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You'll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.

 

What you'll do

  • Own the implementation journey end-to-end, from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

  • Translate complexity into clarity: design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

  • Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers' unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

  • Be the client's trusted partner: anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp's automation.

  • Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

  • Feed the product loop: surface what isn't working and translate that feedback into long-term platform improvements.

 

What you'll bring

Key attributes for success

  • Ownership and autonomy. You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

  • Managing ambiguity. You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

  • Growth mindset. You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

  • Problem solving and critical thinking. You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

  • Customer-first mentality. You think beyond implementation and care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills: you can translate business needs into technical action.

  • Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

  • Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus.

  • Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 

What you'll get

  • High ownership environment. You shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale. Your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure. Work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth. Fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership. Be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team. Become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure. Be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits and offsites. Paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

description_html:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Associate – International Operations & Site Build-up bist du eine treibende Kraft hinter einer unserer strategisch wichtigen Initiativen. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und übernimmst Ownership für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Operations-Hubs in Kairo – von der strategischen Konzeption bis in die operative Umsetzung (z. B. PMO für unsere Aufbau-Initiativen, Design des Operating Models für neue Funktionen, Prozessoptimierung gemeinsam mit den Teams vor Ort). Dabei baust du die Brücke zwischen unseren Teams in Deutschland und Ägypten – mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung, steiler Lernkurve und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum vom ersten Tag an.

  • Ramp-up Planung Du entwickelst detaillierte Pläne für den Aufbau neuer Teams und Funktionen in Kairo – inklusive Wissensaufbau und Ressourcenplanung.

  • Operating Model & Prozessdesign Du gestaltest das Operating Model für die neuen Funktionen, prüfst Workflows auf Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit und optimierst die Prozesse gemeinsam mit dem Team.

  • PMO & Program Governance Du baust das PMO-Framework für unsere Aufbau-Initiativen auf, steuerst Timelines und schaffst Transparenz für die Führung an beiden Standorten.

  • Financial Tracking Du verfolgst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung gegen den Business Case und machst die Ergebnisse für die Geschäftsführung transparent.

  • Continuous Improvement

  • Cross-functional Collaboration Du bist eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen allen internen Bereichen in Deutschland und in Kairo und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven pragmatisch zusammen.

Dein Profil

  • Relevante Erfahrung 2–4 Jahre in Top-Tier Consulting oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Aufbau internationaler Standorte (z. B. in einem GCC, BPO oder Shared-Service-Center).

  • Strukturierte Problemlösung Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Situationen und übersetzt unklare Ausgangslagen in pragmatische Lösungen – auf dem Papier und im Alltag.

  • Business Case & Financial Acumen Du fühlst Dich sicher in Business Cases, Cost-Benefit-Analysen und KPI-Tracking und begründest wirtschaftliche Entscheidungen fundiert.

  • Eigenverantwortung & Umsetzungsstärke Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Workstreams und bringst Themen mit hoher Eigenständigkeit ins Ziel – hands-on, pragmatisch, ergebnisorientiert.

  • Interkulturelle Kommunikationsstärke Klar und adressatengerecht – vom Werkstudiernden bis zum Management, über Standort- und Kulturgrenzen hinweg. Deutsch und Englisch auf C1+ Niveau.

  • Reisebereitschaft Ca. eine Woche pro Monat vor Ort in Kairo, die restliche Zeit aus unserem Office in Berlin.

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

What you'll do

Enpal is transforming its ERP landscape from a traditional D365 F&O setup into an Agentic Enterprise, a clean D365 core with an AI-native execution layer on top. AI-native product squads, organized by E2E process domain (D2O, O2C, P2P, SCE, R2R, MDG), replace traditional workstream towers. Each squad includes a Business Intent Owner (BIO), a Technology Orchestrator, Context Engineers, and Harness Engineers. This role sits in the Finance (R2R, O2C, MDG) squad and is a core contributor to building the agentic operating model that will power Enpal at scale.

As Lead Functional Consultant, you own the Finance & SCM architecture across D365 F&O, defining how GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, and Project Accounting are structured, governed, and evolved across 30+ legal entities. You set the design standards that functional consultants, developers, and partners work within, lead the decisions that are hard to reverse, and ensure that the Finance platform is the trusted, auditable system of record that a complex, multi-entity enterprise demands. In the agentic enterprise, you are also the architectural authority for the Finance agent layer, ensuring that Continuous Close Agents, Revenue Assurance Agents, and Collections Agents operate on a platform that is deterministic, traceable, and financially compliant.

FINANCE ARCHITECTURE & AGENTIC FOUNDATION

  • Define, govern, and evolve the Finance architecture across modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, Project Accounting, and Cost Accounting

  • Design the architectural foundation for Finance AI agents, ensuring the D365 core provides the deterministic ledger, traceable decisions, and full audit trail that agentic operations require

  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, regulatory requirements (IFRS/local GAAP), and global design principles across all legal entities

  • Translate complex Finance business requirements into robust D365 F&O designs, clean-core first, with customizations only where legally required or business-critical

STANDARDIZATION & GLOBAL ROLLOUT

  • Drive standardization, harmonization, and process simplification across regions and legal entities, ensuring the pilot BU design is locked and rolled out consistently

  • Ensure all Finance solutions are designed in a reliable, robust, and scalable way, ready for rollout across 30+ legal entities in the M9–M15 timeframe

  • Lead solution governance, blueprinting, and architectural decision-making across the Finance domain

  • Provide thought leadership on best practices, industry trends, and Microsoft ecosystem capabilities, including Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft Fabric

DELIVERY LEADERSHIP & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

  • Provide hands-on guidance to functional consultants, developers, and integration teams, ensuring high-quality delivery across design, build, testing, cutover, and hypercare

  • Ensure high-quality delivery across design, build, testing, cutover, and support phases

  • Represent Finance architecture in ERP governance forums, design authority reviews, and steering committees up to CFO level

What you'll bring

  • Extensive experience in ERP Finance & SCM transformation, with significant hands-on experience in D365 F&O Finance across multiple modules and global rollouts

  • Proven architectural leadership designing end-to-end Finance solutions, including integrations, data models, extensions, and ISV evaluations, ideally within high-growth or complex organizations

  • Deep functional expertise in core Finance processes (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash & Bank, Project Accounting, Cost Accounting) and strong understanding of IFRS/local GAAP

  • Strong fluency in D365 F&O architecture, including data entities and integration patterns

  • Understanding of or strong interest in agentic AI in Finance: how Continuous Close Agents, Revenue Assurance Agents, and Collections Agents operate, and what the platform must provide to support them

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, including Finance Directors and CFO, with clear communication and decision-making

  • Experience leading global implementations across multiple legal entities, including fit-gap analysis, blueprinting, solution governance, and change management

  • Collaborative leadership mindset that brings cross-functional teams together and drives clarity in complex global programs

  • Fluency in English; German is a plus

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

Why this role matters

Finance is the most governance-critical domain in Enpal's ERP transformation. In the agentic enterprise, Finance agents, Continuous Close, Revenue Assurance, Collections & Credit, will automate the workflows that today consume weeks of manual effort across 30+ legal entities. As Lead Functional Consultant – D365 F&O Finance & SCM, you design the platform those agents operate on. The quality of your architecture directly determines the auditability, accuracy, and scalability of Enpal's financial operations at scale.

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 + 2 vacation days, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

title: Partner Success Manager (w/m/d)

description_html:
Als Partner Success Manager (m/w/d) sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Partner Enpal Financial Solutions erfolgreich nutzen und langfristig erfolgreich mit uns zusammenarbeiten. Du begleitest sie vom Onboarding bis in den laufenden Alltag, hilfst bei operativen Herausforderungen, erkennst Aktivierungspotenziale und stellst sicher, dass unsere Finanzierungslösung im Vertriebsprozess wirklich genutzt wird.

Dabei bist Du nicht nur Ansprechpartner für unsere Partner und deren Kunden, sondern ein zentraler Hebel für Partnererfolg, Prozessqualität und Wachstum. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen, bringst Feedback aus dem Markt direkt ins Unternehmen ein und hilfst dabei, unsere Abläufe, Tools und Wissensbasis kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Die Rolle ist ideal für Dich, wenn Du Verantwortung übernehmen, strukturiert arbeiten und in einem dynamischen Umfeld echten Impact haben möchtest.

Dein Spielfeld

Partneraktivierung & Partnererfolg

  • Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio an Installateur-Partnern und sorgst dafür, dass sie EFS aktiv und erfolgreich nutzen.

  • Du begleitest neue Partner durch ein strukturiertes Onboarding und schaffst die Grundlage für einen schnellen, reibungslosen Start.

  • Du verantwortest die Performance deines Partnerportfolios anhand definierter KPIs.

  • Du erkennst früh, wo Nutzung, Aktivierung oder Abschlussraten hinter den Möglichkeiten zurückbleiben, und leitest proaktiv Maßnahmen ein.

  • Du identifizierst inaktive oder gefährdete Partner frühzeitig und unterstützt dabei, diese wieder erfolgreich zu aktivieren.

  • Du analysierst Installations- und Abschlusszahlen und leitest daraus verständliche, relevante Insights für andere Teams ab.

Endkunden- & Installateur-Support

  • Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für operative Fragen von Installateuren, deren Vertriebsteams und Endkunden.

  • Du bearbeitest Support-Anfragen schnell, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und sorgst für eine verlässliche Betreuung im Tagesgeschäft.

  • Du priorisierst und eskalierst komplexe Fälle sinnvoll und arbeitest eng mit internen Teams an nachhaltigen Lösungen.

Prozesse, Wissen & Strategie

  • Du baust unsere Knowledge Base aktiv weiter aus und erstellst Support-Artikel, FAQs und Onboarding-Materialien.

  • Du dokumentierst wiederkehrende Herausforderungen aus dem Partneralltag und leitest Verbesserungspotenziale für Prozesse, Tools und Zusammenarbeit ab.

  • Du bringst strukturiertes Feedback aus dem Markt in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und internen Abläufe ein.

  • Du hilfst dabei, ein skalierbares Partner-Success-Setup mit klaren Standards, guter Dokumentation und hoher Prozessqualität aufzubauen.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du bringst erste relevante Erfahrung in Customer Success, B2B-Support, Account Management, Operations oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und empathisch – sowohl mit Partnern als auch intern.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Themen gleichzeitig den Überblick.

  • Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Prozesse nicht nur zu leben, sondern aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools wie Chat- oder Ticketsystemen.

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau und kommunizierst sicher und fließend auf Englisch in einem professionellen Umfeld.

Was Dich bei EFS erwartet

  • Echter Impact: Du gestaltest den Erfolg unserer Partner und unser Wachstum aktiv mit.

  • Ownership ab Tag 1: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

  • Steile Lernkurve: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Operations und Product.

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Fixgehalt plus Performance-Bonus mit klaren Zielen.

  • Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Viel Raum, um mit uns zu wachsen.

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest Go-to-Market-Strategien – von Zielgruppenanalyse über Wettbewerbsanalyse bis zur Identifikation von Marktchancen

  • Du koordinierst funktionsübergreifende Teams und sorgst für erfolgreiche Produktlaunches – gemeinsam mit Marketing, Sales und Customer Operations

  • Du analysierst Performance-KPIs, erkennst Hebel zur Verbesserung und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen zur Optimierung ab

  • Du studierst in einem wirtschaftsnahen, technischen oder techaffinen Bereich

  • Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrung in Go-to-Market, Product/Commercial, Consulting, Business Development oder in einem Start-up bzw. Scale-up Umfeld mit

  • Du arbeitest analytisch und strukturiert, bist sicher im Umgang mit Excel oder Google Sheets und leitest aus Markt- und KPI-Daten präzise, umsetzbare Empfehlungen ab

Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt.   • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt

title: Working Student Office Management Support (m/f/d)

description_html:
Unser Unternehmen

Mindpeak ist ein in Hamburg ansässiges KI-Unternehmen, das sich der Demokratisierung der Krebsdiagnostik verschrieben hat. Unsere Software unterstützt Patholog:innen dabei, Krebserkrankungen schneller und genauer zu erkennen, indem sie modernste Deep-Learning-Verfahren auf medizinische Bilder anwendet. Unsere KI-Lösung ist die erste, die in den USA in der klinischen Histopathologie für die Primärdiagnostik eingesetzt wird, und wird weltweit in Routineabläufen genutzt.

Wir stellen uns einer zentralen Herausforderung im modernen Gesundheitswesen: dem wachsenden Bedarf an medizinischer Bildanalyse bei einer gleichbleibenden Anzahl an Krebsexpert:innen. Durch die Bereitstellung leistungsstarker, robuster Tools für die visuelle Diagnose helfen wir Patholog:innen, sich auf das zu konzentrieren, was nur Menschen am besten können – während unsere Technologie den Rest übernimmt.

Die Stelle

Wir suchen für 6 Monate jemanden proaktives und detailorientiertes im Bereich Office Management (m/w/d) zur Unterstützung in unserem Management and Operations Team. In dieser Rolle bist du ein:e wichtige:r Ansprechpartner:in für das gesamte Team und erhältst Einblicke in verschiedene Geschäftsbereiche, in denen du deine Stärken einbringen kannst. Du kümmerst dich regelmäßig um Bestellungen und die Ordnung im Büro und unterstützt unser Office Management bei diversen anfallenden Aufgaben. Dabei kommunizierst du sicher auf Deutsch und auf Englisch. Diese Position bietet die wertvolle Gelegenheit, in einem agilen, innovativen Umfeld zu arbeiten und direkt zum Erfolg unseres Unternehmens beizutragen.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Erfahrung als Büroassistent:in, Assistent:in der Geschäftsleitung oder in einer vergleichbaren administrativen Position ist von Vorteil.

  • Motivation: Hohes Engagement und Lust, deine Fähigkeiten in ein missionsorientiertes KI-Unternehmen im Gesundheitsbereich einzubringen.

  • Organisation: Hervorragende Organisations- und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu bewältigen und Prioritäten effektiv zu setzen.

  • Kommunikation: Hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office / Google Docs und modernen Terminplanungs-Tools.

  • Einstellung: Eine zuverlässige, präzise und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, kombiniert mit einer serviceorientierten „Hands-on“-Mentalität.

  • Soziale Kompetenz: Professionelles und freundliches Auftreten, Flexibilität und ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative.

  • Vertrauen: Absolute Diskretion im Umgang mit vertraulichen Informationen.

  • Verfügbarkeit: ca. vier Tage Präsenz bei uns vor Ort, in Abstimmung mit deinem Studium. Die Stelle ist auf 6 Monate befristet.

Was Mindpeak bietet

  • Motivation: Ein dynamisches und unterstützendes Umfeld in einem schnell wachsenden KI-Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen, das wirklich etwas bewegt.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Kultur: Ein kooperatives und innovatives Team, das sich für positive Veränderungen im Gesundheitswesen einsetzt.

  • Abwechslung: Ein Zuständigkeitsbereich, der immer wieder neue Aufgaben bietet

title: Deployment Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Lyceum
description_html:
The Role

Deploying the infrastructure our compute runs on is one of the most important missions at Lyceum. This role secures that infrastructure and brings it online – from the data center it lives in to the GPU clusters that power everything we do.

You will map the European data center landscape, assess which sites are available and which are genuinely worth pursuing on both commercial and technical grounds, and take ownership of deployment: the hands-on work of designing, procuring, and bringing GPU clusters online on site. The role spans sourcing, negotiation, cluster design, procurement, and technical execution, with end-to-end ownership across all of them. Successful candidates rely less on detailed knowledge of specifications than on sound judgment, persistence, and the ability to work effectively with both the providers who control the space and the engineers who rely on it.

What You'll Own

  • Site sourcing and evaluation. Identify and assess data center capacity across Europe, determining which sites are available and worth pursuing on both commercial and technical grounds.

  • Cluster design and procurement. Translate compute requirements into concrete cluster designs, and own the procurement of the hardware needed to bring them to life.

  • Deployment ownership. Lead the technical execution of installing and bringing clusters online within the data center, end to end.

  • Market mapping and relationships. Build and maintain relationships across data center providers and the wider hardware and infrastructure ecosystem, and keep a current, reliable view of available capacity across the market.

  • Cross-functional alignment. Translate cluster requirements into site and provider decisions, and hold delivery to the agreed plan.

What We're Looking For

  • A technical foundation. You've brought a cluster online before, ideally supported by an engineering background (civil, structural, or similar) and several years of relevant professional experience.

  • Exceptional ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes and see them through to completion.

  • Strong interpersonal skills. The role is highly relationship-driven – across providers, vendors, and internal teams – and depends on your ability to build trust and work well with others.

  • Fluency across technical and commercial domains. You can assess a site's engineering realities and evaluate the commercial merits of a deal, moving comfortably between the two.

  • An established network on the hardware and data center side of the industry (not a must).

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

  • European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech

title: Machine Learning Consultant (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Machine Learning Reply
description_html:
Company overview: 

Machine Learning Reply provides customized end-to-end solutions in the data science field that cover the entire project life cycle - from initial strategic consulting to data architecture and infrastructure topics, through to data processing and quality assurance using machine learning algorithms. We enable our customers to successfully implement new data-driven business models as well as optimize existing processes and products, with a focus on open-source and cloud technologies. 

We are looking for a skilled and motivated consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a technical background and be able to provide support to our clients in using cloud-based solutions. We are looking for someone who has a solid understanding of Software Development, has an interest in Cloud-based Solutions, and shares our passion for Data and AI. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Research and prototype new ideas for disrupting day-to-day operations & create new value for our clients across all industries 

  • Implement customer-specific use cases and guide our client through the entire lifecycle from creative workshops to implementation 

  • Apply your skills to help our clients improve their data usage through data modeling & data visualization 

  • Develop data science use cases

  • Develop and coordinate infrastructure projects (e.g., the introduction of cloud data lakes & data warehouses) 

  • Research and prototype new ideas for disrupting day-to-day operations & create new value for our clients across all industries  

What we offer you: 

  • Access to work on projects across industries (large and mid-market companies in Banking, Insurance, Automotive, Retail, etc.) 

  • Broaden your skills through interdisciplinary work and training in the areas of data engineering, software engineering, cloud architecture, and data science 

  • Benefit from industry-leading cooperations

  • Very active social program - including training, conferences, team buildings, Reply Exchange, communities of practices, and hackathons 

  • Work in an open, flat environment, within a broad Reply knowledge-sharing network 

  • Award-winning office space in downtown Munich with access to “Stammstrecke” 

  • Public transport ticket with Deutschlandticket 

  • Gym-membership subsidy for a gym of your choice 

  • Flexible work environment between client, Reply office, and remote work 


Job requirements 

Minimum Job Requirements / Qualifications: 

  • Experience and/or interest in the area of artificial intelligence. 

  • Experience in relational databases & knowledge of SQL. 

  • Experience in at least one additional programming language (e.g. Python, Java, …). 

  • Experience using LLMs (Agents, RAG, VectorDBs, …).

  • Knowledge of visualization and frontend technologies strongly preferred. 

  • Bachelor’s and Master’s degree and a strong quantitative background, for example, in Business Informatics, Business Science (with an additional background in Informatics), Computer Science, or Data Science.

  • Fluent in English and able to speak German at least at a C1 Level. This requirement is mandatory.

Desired: 

  • Experience in cloud infrastructure development and management 

  • Experience in the consulting industry 

  • Knowledge of technologies like Kubernetes, Docker, or Spark is a plus. 

  • Interest in (agile) project management. 

 

What are you waiting for? 

Join our team at  Machine Learning Reply as a Consultant in Munich or Berlin!

title: Agentic AI Software Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Machine Learning Reply
description_html:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with hands-on experience in modern AI systems, including agentic AI and generative AI applications. You will support our clients in designing and building intelligent, production-ready systems that leverage LLMs, autonomous agents, and scalable cloud architectures. 

Responsibilities:

·      Design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade systems on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

·      Develop and operate agentic AI systems, including multi-step workflows, tool integration, and autonomous decision-making components.

·      Lead end-to-end implementation of AI-driven features, from prototyping (PoC) to production deployment.

·      Build high-performance APIs and backend services for AI applications using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Spring Boot.

·      Integrate generative AI solutions (LLMs, vector databases, RAG pipelines, orchestration frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph) into enterprise environments.

·      Design and implement robust orchestration and retrieval pipelines for scalable AI applications.

·      Set up and maintain MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and CI/CD workflows for continuous integration, evaluation, and deployment.

·      Ensure software quality through testing, monitoring, observability, and performance optimization.

·      Collaborate closely with clients and cross-functional teams to identify requirements and deliver impactful AI solutions.

 

What we offer you:

·      Work on innovative AI and Software Engineering projects across industries (Banking, Insurance, Automotive, Retail, etc.).

·      Expand your skills in areas such as MLOps, cloud architecture, data engineering, and generative AI.

·      Collaborate with top technology partners in the cloud, AI, and automation ecosystem.

·      Access to training, certifications, and interdisciplinary projects.

·      Join a vibrant community with hackathons, conferences, and knowledge-sharing events.

·      Award-winning office space in downtown Munich with great transport connections.

·      Flexible working model between client site, Reply office, and remote work.

Deutschlandticket for public


Job requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

·      Completed university studies with a strong quantitative or technical background (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or similar).

·      Ideally, you have already gained some initial consulting and project management experience Teamwork & Collaboration – ability to work effectively with others toward common objectives.

·      Adaptability – flexibility in taking on different roles within a team and understand the need of the costumer

·      Solid programming experience in at least two programming languages such as Python, Java, Rust, or JavaScript.

·      Practical experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments (on-premises or cloud).

·      Experience with different database technologies, including SQL and NoSQL, with knowledge of database design, data modeling, and data management.

·      Experience with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and integrating generative AI into actual solutions.

·      Strong communication skills for explaining technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.

·      Fluent in English and at least C1-level German. This requirement is mandatory.

 

 

Desired Qualifications:

·      Hands-on experience with cloud AI services.

·      Understanding of MLOps concepts (model registry, monitoring, CI/CD).

·      Knowledge of modern AI/ML frameworks and tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, or OpenAI APIs.

·      Awareness of software engineering principles (SOLID, testing, version control).

·      Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

·      Cloud certifications are a plus.

·      Teamwork & Collaboration – ability to work effectively with others toward common objectives.

·      Adaptability – flexibility in taking on different roles within a team and understand the need of the costumer

 

What are you waiting for?

Join our team at Machine Learning Reply as a Consultant for Software Engineering and AI in Munich or Berlin!

description_html:
We are currently looking for an HR Generalist join our international HR Department, and provide support to our offices in Germany.

The post-holder is responsible to provide a robust HR service and support to the Human Resources Department’s daily operations: personnel administration, benefits, payroll etc. He/she mainly works within a framework of established HR processes, procedures and standard work instructions as determined by the centralised HR department and applicable local country legislations.

  • Minimum 4 years HR experience within a multinational company

  • Ability to work effectively and independently across organizational boundaries

  • Maintain flexibility to take on additional responsibilities, as needed

title: Digital Marketing Manager (m/w/d) Schwerpunkt Website, SEO & digitale Sichtbarkeit
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at cbs Corporate Business Solutions GmbH
description_html:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Ziel der Position

Du entwickelst und verantwortest unsere Corporate Website als zentrale Plattform für Positionierung, Sichtbarkeit und Leadgenerierung.

Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Aufbau einer modernen, performanten und suchoptimierten digitalen Präsenz, die unsere Marke im Markt klar positioniert und nachhaltig in relevanten Informations- und Suchräumen sichtbar macht – von klassischer Suche bis hin zu AI-basierten Systemen.

Gemeinsam mit Content-, Campaign- und Business-Teams sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Themen genau dort gefunden werden, wo unsere Zielgruppen nach Lösungen suchen.

Du berichtet an den Head of Digital Marketing

Was Dich erwartet

  • Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb der Corporate Website als zentrale Image- und Leadplattform (Struktur, UX, Inhalte, Conversion)

  • Steuerung und Umsetzung der SEO-Strategie (technisch, strukturell und inhaltlich) zur nachhaltigen Steigerung der Sichtbarkeit

  • Optimierung der digitalen Auffindbarkeit in modernen Suchsystemen inkl. AI-getriebener Suche und neuer Informationskanäle

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von Website- und Content-Strukturen entlang der Customer Journey (Awareness bis Conversion)

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Content-, Campaign- und Fachbereichen zur Entwicklung such- und zielgruppenrelevanter Inhalte

  • Analyse und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Website-Performance (Traffic, Rankings, Engagement, Conversion)

  • Steuerung externer Dienstleister und Agenturen (z. B. Entwicklung, SEO, Content)


Was wir uns wünschen

  • >5 Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen B2B-Marketing mit Fokus auf Website und SEO, idealerweise im Beratungs-, Technologie- oder Professional-Services-Umfeld

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Content-Strukturen, digitalen Customer Journeys und Suchmaschinenlogiken,

  • Gespür für digitale Markenführung, Inhalte und Nutzererlebnis

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen CMS-, SEO- und Analytics-Tools

  • Analytisches Denken und Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Optimierungspotenziale abzuleiten

  • Teamplayer mit Humor, Leidenschaft, Kommunikationsfähigkeit und eigenverantwortlicher sowie ergebnisorientierter Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Erfahrung im internationalen Kontext von Vorteil

Unsere Benefits:

Aus- und Weiterbildung

Fachspezifische Schulungen und Weiterbildungsangebote

Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung

Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Zusatzversicherungen, diverse Sportangebote wie Urban Sports Club, Yoga etc.

Events

Beratertage, Weihnachtsfeier, Sommerfest, Teamevents, Alumni-Treffen, Jubiläumsfeiern und -reisen

Prämien

Attraktive Gehaltsmodelle, Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprämien

Arbeitszeiten

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, mobiles Arbeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub, Workation

Ausstattung

Firmenhandy (iPhone), Notebook / Macbook, Mitarbeiter PC Programm, Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, Kostenlose Getränke, Gemeinschaftsräume mit Wohlfühlcharakter

Mobiliät

Mobilitätspauschale, Bahncard, Jobrad

Zuwendungen

Zuschüsse für Kindergarten/Kita und außerordentliche Zuwendungen je Lebenssituation und Betriebszugehörigkeit

title: Principal Software Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at 1KOMMA5˚
description_html:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?
We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Your mission

  • Shape the organisation's technical strategy and innovation efforts
  • Accountable for consistent execution of technical decisions by setting clear direction and holding teams accountable for implementation
  • Ensure continuously that our software architecture is shaped in close alignment with product management to support current and future product direction
  • Lead architectural direction to enable the delivery of scalable, maintainable, and state-of-the-art solutions
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Tackle and resolve deep technical challenges with urgency and precision
  • Mentor and challenge engineers to accelerate their professional growth
  • Build and scale a high-performance tech organisation and engineering culture
  • Embed security and reliability as direct customer value
  • Architect our systems and APIs so AI agents operate as first-class users with machine-readable contracts and structured errors that let agents self-correct
  • Drive the org's transformation to agentic engineering, reshaping how teams work so agents execute safely while humans stay accountable

Technologies you will work with include:

  • AI-assisted development with Cursor and agentic coding workflows
  • Cloud & Infra: Google Cloud Platform, GKE (Kubernetes), Cloud Run, Terraform/IaC, Vercel
  • Messaging & IoT: Eclipse Hono, MQTT, Mender
  • Data & BI: PostgreSQL, BigQuery, SQLMesh, Looker
  • Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry
  • Languages: TypeScript (Nest.js), Java, Go, Flutter, Ruby on Rails
  • DevOps: CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
  • Linear, Notion, Figma, Miro

Your profile

  • Extensive hands-on experience in software development with multiple general-purpose programming languages for a minimum of 5 years
  • A proven track record of architecting scalable and secure systems, demonstrating a strong commitment to quality
  • Extensive experience in designing and implementing APIs that enable seamless integration and system communication
  • An agile and result-oriented mindset, with a strong emphasis on collaboration and teamwork
  • Experience communicating with stakeholders in business terms and understanding the technical implications of their requirements
  • Industry-leading experience driving cross-functional teams and enforcing engineering alignment in fast-paced environments, including making and following through on critical technical decisions
  • Experience designing systems and APIs for agent consumption, with structured errors and clear contracts that let agents self-correct
  • Capability to guide an engineering team through the shift to agentic engineering, reshaping workflows so agents execute safely while humans stay accountable for every outcome
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with proficiency in German considered a plus

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time
  • Individualised opportunities for professional development
  • Reporting directly to the CTO

description_html:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Gudensberg suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen verantwortungsvollen und verlässlichen Leiter Supply Chain Office (m/w/d) .

Informationen über den Standort und die Ausrüstung, an der du arbeiten wirst.

Unser Betrieb in Gudensberg in Hessen spielt eine essenzielle Rolle bei der Produktion frischer Geflügelspezialitäten. Mit einer großen und innovativen Produktpalette versorgen wir nicht nur den deutschen Lebensmitteleinzelhandel, sondern auch Großverbraucher und die Cateringbranche. Erstklassige Qualität steht dabei immer im Mittelpunkt.

Deine Tätigkeiten

  • Leitung des Planungsprozesses in Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen der Produktionsabteilungen

  • Sicherstellung einer optimalen Auslastung der Produktionskapazität durch ausreichende Warenverfügbarkeiten

  • Optimierung der Ressourcen und Personalplanung in Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen der Produktionsabteilungen

  • Einrichtung einer möglichst effizienten Produktionssteuerung

  • Machbarkeitsprüfungen für die Produktion inkl. Aktionsgeschäft

  • Durchführung von Fortschrittskontrollen bei der Planung und Einleitung von Maßnahmen

  • Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit den Planungsabteilungen der weiteren Werke der Gruppe zurbesseren Erfüllung der Kundenbedürfnisse

  • Verantwortung für die Mitarbeitenden des Supply Chain Office

  • Fachliche Führung der Bereiche Lager und Versand am Standort

Wie sieht der/die ideale Kandidat/- in aus?

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor / Master), vorzugsweise Betriebswirtschaft oder Supply Chain Management bzw. vergleichbare Ausbildung

  • Gute Kenntnisse und Affinität zu Datenverarbeitung und -analyse

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen in der Lebensmittel- oder FMCG-Umgebung ist wünschenswert

  • Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit Software für die Bedarfsplanung wären ebenfalls hilfreich

  • Gute Kenntnisse der deutschen und englischen Sprache in Wort und Schrift

  • Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und gutes Zahlenverständnis

  • Hohe Ergebnis- und Kundenorientierung

  • Ausgeprägte Eigenschaften für Planung und Organisation

  • Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen und zielgerichteten Informationsflusses innerhalb des Teams sowie zu angrenzenden Fachbereichen.

Das bieten wir

  • Dich erwartet eine spannende Herausforderung mit viel Raum für eigene Ideen und Mitgestaltung in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

  • Halte dich fit mit unserem Firmenfitnessprogramm – wir bezuschussen deine Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft im Rahmen des EGYM Wellpass-Verbundes.

  • Sei umweltfreundlich unterwegs mit unserem E-Bike-Leasing – eine attraktive Option für deine tägliche Mobilität.

  • Sichere dir attraktive Rabatte auf unsere Produkte – ein Plus, das sich lohnt!

  • Parke stressfrei und kostenlos – direkt bei uns am Arbeitsplatz.

  • Empfiehl uns als Arbeitgeber weiter und freue dich über attraktive Prämien, wenn du neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen zu uns bringst.

  • Dank unseres strukturierten Onboarding-Programms findest du dich schnell zurecht und startest erfolgreich bei uns durch.

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?

Wenn du Lust auf neue Herausforderungen hast, freuen wir uns darauf , dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb dich direkt über die grüne Schaltfläche oder das untenstehende Bewerbungsformular. Wenn du noch Fragen zu dieser Stelle hast, kannst du uns telefonisch oder per E-Mail kontaktieren. Du erhältst so schnell wie möglich eine Rückmeldung.

Plukon Gudensberg GmbH
Herr Ronny Böhme
Personalabteilung
Besserstr 45, 34281 Gudensberg
Telefon: +49 (0) 1522 2628 934
E-Mail:

Akquise im Zusammenhang mit dieser Stellenausschreibung ist nicht erwünscht.

Für welches Unternehmen wirst Du arbeiten?

Arbeiten bei Plukon bedeutet, an verantwortungsvoller Ernährung von 265 Mio. Verbraucherinnen und Verbrauchern in Europa zu arbeiten. Unser Sortiment reicht von Mahlzeitkomponenten bis hin zu Fertiggerichten, darunter Salate. Die Zutaten hierfür sind Geflügelfleischprodukte (unsere Basis), aber immer öfter auch Gemüse und alternative Proteine. So haben wir ein Angebot für Fleischfreundinnen und -freunde, Flexitarierinnen und Flexitarier und Vegetarierinnen und Vegetarier. Sie finden unsere Produkte im Kühlregal von Supermärkten und in Schnellrestaurants.

title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ahead Gmbh
description_html:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch.

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! 


YOUR TASKS

  • End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions.

  • Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed.

  • Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production.

  • Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start.

  • Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving.

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

  • You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations.

  • You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements.

  • You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially.

  • You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

  • Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products.

  • Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management.

  • Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing.

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

  • Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget
This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you!


Disclaimer

title: E-Commerce Campaign Manager (All Genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ahead Gmbh
description_html:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we’re on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We create the snacks people genuinely crave, from chocolate bars and wafers to cookies, gummies, and protein bars, with up to 90% less sugar and no compromise on taste.

As our E-Commerce Campaign Manager, you’ll work at the intersection of our products, customer experience, and commercial growth. You’ll help shape how ahead brings ideas to life online and scales them across markets.

You’ll take ownership of our onsite campaigns and bring our overarching campaign strategy to life in our shop. You’ll improve the processes behind them, develop & implement new ideas for new campaign-related shop features, and turn campaign data into actionable insights. Working closely with our E-Commerce, Campaign, Brand, and Marketing teams, you’ll help make our campaigns more effective, scalable, and relevant across markets.

If you’re commercially curious, highly detail oriented, and motivated by the opportunity to shape both the customer experience and the way we do e-commerce, we’d love to hear from you!


YOUR TASKS

  • Onsite Campaign Experience & Launches: Plan and execute product launches, discount initiatives, and other commercial activities in the shop. Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders to ensure a smooth customer experience.

  • Content & Asset Ownership: Coordinate the creation of product and shop content, including images, copy, homepage content, launch pages, and other onsite assets. Take full responsibility for their quality, accuracy, and timely delivery, including localization for expansion markets. Ensure content is adapted to local needs and delivered consistently across countries.

  • Shop Development: Together with our Tech team, transform the campaign vision into new shop features, promotional mechanics, and onsite experiences that can improve customer engagement and commercial performance.

  • Process Improvement: Improve how onsite activities are planned, created, and delivered by establishing clearer workflows, strengthening collaboration and handovers, and reducing avoidable errors. Find ways to shorten delivery timelines and assess recurring tasks for automation or AI support. Develop scalable ways of working while using sound judgment about where communication, coordination, and creative thinking remain essential.

  • Performance & Insights: Analyze completed onsite activities, from product launch revenue and discount uplift to top-selling products and other relevant performance indicators, and translate your findings into clear recommendations for future initiatives.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You have practical experience in onsite campaign management, shop management, e-commerce, or a similar field. Hands-on experience with onsite campaigns or shop management is essential. 

  • You are highly organized, structured, and accurate. You have a low tolerance for errors and take full responsibility for the quality of your work, particularly when managing product copy, campaign assets, and launch details.

  • You combine attention to detail with commercial curiosity. You don’t just execute campaigns – you want to understand what drives performance, what can be improved, and how new ideas can create better results. 

  • You are proactive and hands-on. You identify problems, challenge inefficient processes, and follow through on solutions. You’re comfortable working across a broad range of tasks in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently in both German and English. You enjoy coordinating with multiple stakeholders and can work effectively with E-Commerce, Marketing, Brand & Design, and other internal teams.

  • You have a basic understanding of D2C business models, digital marketing, and e-commerce performance.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • You are confident working with Shopify. Hands-on Shopify experience is essential for this role.

  • You have worked in a D2C business.

  • You are familiar with Asana, Trello, or similar project management tools.

  • You understand shop and e-commerce performance and how onsite activities can contribute to commercial results.

  • A background in food, consumer goods, retail, or another high-campaign environment is a plus.

  • Experience improving processes, automating tasks, or using AI to work more efficiently is a plus.

  • Exposure to localization and international markets is a plus.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Berlin or Hamburg, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget

This role is based in Hamburg or Berlin, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you!
