title: Applied AI Scientist(m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Nc Group
description_html:
About us

NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions.
NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia. 

Job Summary: We build AI platforms that transform complex telecom network data—including drive tests, voice quality, broadband diagnostics, and signaling analysis—into clear, actionable insights.
We are looking for an Applied AI Scientist who combines strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills. You will model complex problems, develop and prototype ML and agentic AI solutions, and turn them into reliable, production-ready tools for real users while applying the latest developments in AI.


Responsibilities

  • Design and build agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines that can reason over technical documentation and live network data.
  • Take ownership of testing and evaluation by developing evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks for accuracy, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Ensure system quality can be measured reliably and regressions are identified before reaching users.
  • Develop and continuously improve our evaluation and observability practices, including offline and online evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge approaches where appropriate, regression testing, and quality dashboards for agentic AI and RAG systems.
  • Turn data science insights into production-ready solutions, covering the full process from data analysis and modeling to well-tested, maintainable AI tools, including operationalization and MLOps.
  • Develop and enhance machine learning models for classification, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and related use cases, and integrate them into the platform.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, actively contributing to high engineering standards across the team.
  • Research and experiment with new AI models, methods, and technologies, turning promising approaches into practical features and production solutions.
  • Work closely with engineers, data specialists, and domain experts to develop effective solutions for real-world telecom challenges.


Your profile

  • PhD in a quantitative discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Computational Chemistry/Biology, or a related natural science, with strong hands-on experience in mathematical and computational modeling.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience developing software or machine learning systems in an industry or research environment, alongside or following your studies.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents and RAG, including building and implementing LLM-powered systems in practice.
  • Strong background in data science and machine learning, with experience using tools and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, and deep learning frameworks.
  • Strong software engineering and programming skills, particularly in Python, with a focus on clean, well-structured, tested, and maintainable code.
  • Good understanding of the design and development of agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tools, memory, evaluation, and guardrails.
  • A strong research mindset and enthusiasm for keeping up with developments in AI and translating new approaches into practical solutions.
  • Fluent English, combined with strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills.
  • Experience productionizing ML solutions in the cloud, preferably AWS (e.g. Bedrock, ECS, S3), using modern AI and LLM tooling such as LangGraph, Chroma, FAISS, LangSmith, or Langfuse, including LLM evaluation, observability, prompt engineering, and cost and latency optimization is a plus.
  • Exposure to telecom, networking, signal processing, or other data-rich technical domains is a plus.


We Offer

  • Employment Type: Full-Time, indefinite term.
  • Opportunity to shape AI strategy in a fast-growing organization with access to state-of-the-art AI tools, infrastructure, and research opportunities
  • Flexible working hours.
  • 28 vacation days.
  • Health & Sports Subsidy: Sports membership subsidy.
  • Public Transportation Subsidy: Monthly subsidy for a Germany-wide ticket.
  • Bicycle leasing via JobRad.
  • Regular Team Events.

title: Senior GTM Strategy Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Chrono24
description_html:
About

Chrono24 is the world’s leading online marketplace for luxury watches. Driven by a passion for timepieces and technology, we connect buyers and sellers from across the globe. Our goal is to maximise trust and transparency in the watch market.

About

Growth Operations is the engine room of Chrono24’s commercial execution - connecting Marketing, Supply, and VIP Sales with the analytical rigour and operational structure they need to make faster, better decisions. As Senior GTM Strategy Manager, you will be the analytical and operational backbone of the team, reporting to the Chief of Staff and working directly with Growth leadership - and, where relevant, the broader executive leadership - on the commercial questions that most directly determine our growth trajectory. We use AI tools as a matter of course, not an occasional shortcut. We expect this role to use them to compress the time between question, insight, and decision, and to help raise the standard across the team of what good, AI-enabled work looks like.


What you can expect

  • Own research, modelling, and problem-structuring on high-priority strategic questions (e.g. C2C strategy, new go-to-market motions), building scenario analyses rigorous enough to inform decisions and clear enough to present to executive leadership, using AI tools to move faster and think more rigorously.
  • Take cross-functional initiatives from framing through to delivery - including the messy middle of stakeholder coordination, dependency management, and keeping things moving; synthesise inputs into decision-ready recommendations and bring your own point of view rather than presenting options neutrally.
  • Design and maintain Growth’s internal KPI and performance reporting, working with the Data and BI teams to ensure the right metrics are tracked, defined consistently, and surfaced at the right cadence.
  • Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities across our Marketplace and VIP go-to-market motions, and turn complex data into clear narratives for leadership discussions.
  • Own recurring analytical deliverables, including weekly and monthly performance summaries for the Growth leadership team.
  • Act as a thought partner on high-priority strategic initiatives such as US market acceleration and new go-to-market motions (e.g. CPO, certification, consignment).


What sets you apart

  • 5+ years in strategy consulting, investment banking, or a GTM / strategy / business operations role at a top-tier, high-growth technology company.
  • You’ve owned outcomes, not just workstreams: as comfortable driving a cross-functional initiative to completion as building the model that justified it.
  • Strong analytical skills: able to build a model, stress-test assumptions, and know when the numbers are telling you something real versus something convenient; you understand what they mean, not just what they say.
  • Fluent with AI tools: you use LLMs, research agents, and analytical co-pilots as a natural part of how you work, and you’re thoughtful about where they help and where human judgment still leads.
  • Commercial instinct and good judgment about where to invest effort; able to communicate findings clearly to senior stakeholders and make structure where there isn’t any.
  • Demonstrated interest in ecommerce and marketplaces; knowledge of luxury resale or the watch market is a plus. Fluent in English; German is a plus.


What we offer

  • A dynamic and international work environment.
  • The opportunity to contribute significantly to the expansion and success of our company.
  • Attractive compensation and development opportunities.
  • Benefit App: Discover our Benefit App, which offers you complete flexibility. Whether for your sports programme, as a daycare allowance or as a flexible mobility budget, with an additional monthly budget of €80 per person, you can use the benefits individually and design them according to your wishes!
  • Permanent contract: With a permanent contract, we offer you security and perspective in your career. We focus on long-term collaboration and your growth!
  • 30 days’ vacation: Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with 30 days’ vacation a year to relax and gain new inspiration. Your time is valuable - use it how you want!
  • Extra day off on December 24 and 31: Look forward to an extra day off on December 24 and 31 to enjoy the holidays to the full. This leaves more time for family, friends, and festive preparations!
  • Work from abroad 20 days/year: Take advantage of the opportunity to work from abroad for up to 20 days a year and discover new cultures.


Diversity@Chrono24: We believe in the power of diversity.

Diversity is our strength.
At Chrono24, we embrace diversity because we believe it enriches not only our corporate culture but also our success. Be yourself – and let’s achieve great things together!

description_html:
About

Chrono24 is the world's leading marketplace for luxury watches, bringing together watch enthusiasts, collectors, dealers, and buyers from all over the world every day. As a Senior Controller, you'll be part of our Controlling team and actively help shape Chrono24's financial steering. You'll ensure that operational developments are translated into financial impact, take ownership of ongoing cost and P&L controlling including monthly and quarterly reporting, develop scalable controlling and planning processes, and support the Management Board in data-driven decision-making. This role gives you the opportunity to substantially advance our controlling structures — from cost transparency all the way to integrated planning.


What you can expect

  • Financial Steering & Decision Support: You translate operational KPI developments into P&L, EBITDA, and cash impact, and prepare well-founded executive and board materials including commentary
  • Planning, Forecasting & Budget Steering: You drive budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecast processes, steer budgets together with the business units, and develop driver-based financial models as well as integrated cash and working capital planning
  • Cost & Profitability Transparency: You create transparency around OPEX, payment costs, regional contribution margin accounting, and profitability analyses
  • Reporting & Month-End Close: You support the monthly and quarterly close from a controlling perspective, comment on cost and earnings developments, and further develop management and business-unit reporting
  • Systems, Automation & AI: You drive the integration of financials into our data landscape, automate manual processes, and develop AI-supported analysis and commentary workflows
  • Financial Governance: You ensure consistent financial logic (segments, P&L structure, forecast logic) in alignment with BI and Accounting


What sets you apart

  • At least 5 years of experience in Controlling or FP&A, ideally in a digital marketplace or e-commerce environment
  • Solid controlling expertise across the full breadth: cost and P&L controlling, reporting and variance analysis, as well as planning, forecasting, and scenario analysis
  • Ability to translate complex financial relationships into clear, actionable recommendations and communicate them convincingly
  • Experience with ERP/consolidation systems (e.g. LucaNet, DATEV), BI tools (Qlik, Tableau or similar), and planning tools (Pigment, Board or similar)
  • Self-starter mentality, structured way of working, and enthusiasm for actively developing processes and structures
  • Very good English skills, German is a plus

  • A strategically relevant position with real room to shape and build
  • A dynamic, international environment backed by well-known Private Equity investors
  • A modern work environment with flexible hours and hybrid working
  • A benefits app with a monthly allowance of €80 for sports, childcare, or flexible mobility
  • Free lunch that gives you energy and brings the team together
  • A permanent contract with long-term development opportunities
  • 30 days of annual leave
  • Additional days off on December 24th and 31st
  • The option to work up to 20 days per year from abroad

title: Senior Process Engieer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Tozero
description_html:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

description_html:
About us

Since 2000, ITA Logistics Group has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms LetMeShip and ParcelParcel/ LMS Next, companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.


Your mission

As a Working Student (d/f/m) in our Invoicing Team, you will join us at the earliest possible date and support us with reviewing carrier invoices, contributing to efficient and reliable billing processes. You will be part of an international team of seven colleagues, based across Hamburg, Naarden, Nantes, and Madrid.

You can look forward to a working environment where mutual support, team spirit, and positive collaboration are at the heart of how we work.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • You are responsible for reviewing and checking carrier invoices across different brands and countries.

  • You handle related invoice claims and clarify any discrepancies.

  • You review carrier rates and ensure they are correctly reflected in the invoice checks.

  • You gather the information required for invoice checks from relevant stakeholders and coordinate with them.

  • As part of the invoice checking process for LMS Next, you also support the posting of carrier invoices.

  • You support the testing of improvements to the invoice checking process before they are implemented.

  • You support the implementation of our new accounting system, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.


What you need to succeed

  • You are currently enrolled at a university and would like to gain practical experience in invoice checking, accounts payable/receivable, and an international working environment.

  • You enjoy working with numbers and have a careful and accurate approach to your work.

  • You approach your tasks in a structured, efficient, and independent manner.

  • You are open-minded, curious, and enjoy working as part of a team.

  • You have good to very good proficiency in German and English, enabling you to communicate confidently within our international team.

  • Initial knowledge or experience in the transport and logistics sector is an advantage, but not a requirement.


Why ITA Logistics Group?

You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

  • 30 days of vacation

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work 

  • Time tracking and overtime compensation 

  • Subsidized HVV/Deutschlandticket or parking 

  • SpenditCard with a monthly credit of €50

  • Corporate Benefits Program

  • Counseling and support services through the Fürstenberg Institute


Join the ITA Crew

You feel addressed and are interested in joining our team as a Working Student – Invoice Checking (d/f/m) in beautiful Hamburg?
Please apply stating your earliest possible starting date! Ulrike Le Quéré is looking forward to your application. 

We welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, disabilities, sexual orientations, and religions.

Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration if equally qualified.

You can find more information at www.letmeship.com.

title: Sales Solutions Engineer - EMEA
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sonarsource
description_html:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


The Sonar Solutions Engineering team is dedicated to helping our prospective customers achieve technical success with our products. This is your chance to join a growing team as we scale up our efforts to have maximum impact on our targeted customer base. 
 
As a Solutions Engineer at Sonar, you’ll play a central role in providing deep technical expertise to our prospects and supporting them in evaluating our solution. The SE team works as part of the Sales process and also engages with Marketing, Product Management, and Development teams to provide feedback on our products' evolution and messaging.

What you will do daily
  • Help prospective customers understand how our AC/DC approach fits within their software development life cycle
  • Drive technical aspects of pre-sales business opportunities by doing technical presentations and demonstrations and supporting product evaluations 
  • Advise customers on the best alignment of the Sonar solution with their favored deployment strategy
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems encountered by prospective customers evaluating our products
  • Go beyond the sale to ensure successful product adoption and growth following purchase, working with our Customer Success and Support teams
  • Help existing customers understand the additional capabilities of advanced product editions
  • Provide technical enablement to channel partners to raise their level of service

    • Experience and qualifications
  • Some practical experience in software development or DevOps engineering highly desirable
  • Familiarity of both local and cloud-based software deployment platforms and technologies, including Linux, Windows, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure
  • Passion for technology and successful customer outcomes
  • Ability to dive into complex technical problems, perform troubleshooting, develop solutions, and articulate them in verbal and written form
  • Proven ability to work in a team, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge
  • A can-do attitude: challenging the status quo, leading and contributing to key improvements and innovations
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent English, verbal/written communication skills
  • German language is desirable but not a hard requirement.
    •  

    In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Risk Management
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ppro
description_html:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

At PPRO, Senior Software Engineers make some of the most significant decisions for the company. Think of yourself as an important contributor to the success of your team, with a significant impact on the team’s product, but also on its culture and spirit. You will solve complex technical problems, participate in decisions on architecture and technical direction, support and mentor other engineers and work alongside them in the code.

What you’ll do
  • Own products and services end-to-end — backend and UI — including architecting solutions that turn risk into a product, such as our customer
  • facing disputes and chargebacks platform
  • Collaborate and grow in a dynamic and autonomous environment, working to define undefined boundaries in disputes and chargebacks across payment methods
  • Be an integral part of a team, in addition to its culture and ways of working.
  • Common practices include agile methodologies, pair and mob programming
  • Use the latest technologies to solve real problems for our customers at a massive scale
  • Be part of a team that will take full operational responsibility for the services that you own, ensuring security compliance (GDPR) and potentially taking part in an on-call rotation.
  • Share your knowledge and build creative solutions while helping the team evolve best practices

    • What we look for in you
  • Results-orientation, collaborative, pragmatic, and with a continuous improvement mindset
  • Multiple experiences working with Java and Spring Boot 
  • Experience designing and building scalable products and services
  • Experience with the cloud (preferably AWS) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
  • Experience or a strong interest in the complexities of Disputes or Chargebacks
  • Comfortable making UI changes in React; full stack experience is desirable
  • Great problem solving abilities and the ability to articulate tradeoffs of technical problems to a broad audience 
  • Working proficiency in English

    • Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with:
  • Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
  • AWS Cloud components such as EKS, DynamoDB, Kinesis and OpenSearch.
  • Event-driven architectures
  • React, TypeScript
    • What's in it for you?
     
    Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
     
    Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
     
    Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance. 
     
    Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
     
    Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
     
     
    Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
     
    Pet-friendly office - Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side
     
     
    Our Principles: 
     
    We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done.
     
    We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent
     
    We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do.
     
    We make things better: We boldly explore  new ideas and have an unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.
     
    We work as a team: We collaborate closely and value team success over individual achievement.

title: Operations Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Heidi Systems
description_html:
Heidi Systems baut das Energy-OS für Real Estate. Dafür digitalisieren wir einen der letzten großen analogen Märkte Europas und schaffen die Infrastruktur für intelligentes Energiemanagement in Gebäuden.

Wo wir stehen

  • 8 Personen
  • Starke Pipeline mit +5.000 aktiven Deals
  • Angel-Runde mit Unicorn-Foundern sowie Directors von Google und OpenAI
  • Auf dem Weg zu 10x in 2026

Wir rollen die Messdienstbranche neu auf – einen riesigen, verstaubten Markt, den seit Jahrzehnten kaum jemand angefasst hat. Als Prop- und ClimateTech verbinden wir Software, IoT und Operations zu einer Plattform, die Energie- und Verbrauchsdaten erstmals durchgängig digital, transparent und in Echtzeit verfügbar macht.

Wir wachsen stark und suchen jemanden, der unsere operativen Abläufe mit aufbaut, übernimmt und kontinuierlich besser macht.

Als Operations Manager bist du für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer Kundenprojekte verantwortlich. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus einem gewonnenen Auftrag ein sauber umgesetztes Projekt wird – von der ersten Abstimmung über die Koordination aller Beteiligten bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe und laufenden Betreuung.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Founder und dem gesamten Team zusammen, übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung und hast dabei viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Die Rolle ist ausdrücklich nicht als klassische Verwaltungsposition gedacht: Du ownst deine Themen und sorgst dafür, dass sie umgesetzt werden.

Aufgaben

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst End-to-End Ownership für eigene Kunden und Objekte – vom Onboarding bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
  • Du koordinierst Hausverwaltungen, Eigentümer, Installateure, Mieter und weitere Partner und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten zur richtigen Zeit die richtigen Informationen haben
  • Du behältst jederzeit den Überblick über deine Projekte: Was ist erledigt? Was fehlt? Wer wartet auf wen? Was muss als Nächstes passieren?
  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und Partner und sorgst für eine klare, schnelle und verlässliche Kommunikation
  • Du identifizierst manuelle und repetitive Abläufe und entwickelst daraus bessere Prozesse und Systeme
  • Du automatisierst operative Abläufe mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools, z. B. n8n oder Claude Code
  • Du baust interne Strukturen für Projekttracking, Dokumentation und Reporting auf und stellst sicher, dass diese im Alltag tatsächlich genutzt werden
  • Du analysierst operative Kennzahlen, erkennst Engpässe und leitest konkrete Verbesserungen ab
  • Du entwickelst unsere Operations gemeinsam mit dem Founder weiter und übernimmst mit wachsender Verantwortung größere operative Bereiche
  • Du treibst eigene Projekte und Initiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung und misst, ob sie tatsächlich etwas verbessern

Qualifikation

Qualifikation

  • Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium, z. B. in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Immobilienwirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – alternativ vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in Operations, Projektmanagement, Consulting, einem Startup, Real Estate oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld ist ein Plus
  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was als Nächstes zu tun ist
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – du kannst klar und verbindlich mit Kunden, Hausverwaltungen, Installateuren und Partnern kommunizieren und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenbringen
  • Du gehst Probleme pragmatisch an und findest Lösungen, statt sie weiterzugeben
  • Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und Prozesse
  • Du hast Spaß daran, Dinge selbst aufzubauen und bestehende Abläufe kritisch zu hinterfragen
  • Technikaffinität und Interesse an AI, SaaS, IoT oder Automatisierung sind ein Plus
  • Du fühlst dich in einem schnellen Early-Stage-Startup wohl und kannst mit Unklarheit und wechselnden Prioritäten umgehen
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (nicht verhandelbar) sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Benefits

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit und tägliches Mentoring durch einen erfahrenen Gründer und eine extrem steile Lernkurve
  • Teil eines stark wachsenden Early-Stage-Startups zu werden, das einen riesigen Markt digitalisiert – mit viel Eigenverantwortung, hoher Geschwindigkeit und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Echte End-to-End-Verantwortung: Deine Projekte gehören dir – von der ersten Abstimmung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
  • Die Chance, unsere Operations von Anfang an mit aufzubauen und die Prozesse eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens maßgeblich zu prägen
  • Die Möglichkeit, mit wachsender Verantwortung größere operative Bereiche und perspektivisch ein eigenes Team zu übernehmen
  • Zugang zu einem starken Netzwerk in Immobilien, Tech, Energie und Venture Capital
  • Ein High-Performance-Team in einer humorvollen und unterstützenden Kultur, mit regelmäßigen Team-Dinnern und gemeinsamen Events
  • Ein neu renoviertes Altbau-Office in Berlin Mitte direkt am Monbijoupark, gemeinsames Arbeiten an einem Tisch, kurze Wege und direkte Entscheidungen

title: Client Enablement & Coaching Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kraken
description_html:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

title: Sr. Advisor AI Transformation & Automation (w/m/d) E-Commerce
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at IONOS SE
description_html:
Bei IONOS arbeitest Du bei dem führenden europäischen Anbieter von Cloud-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Services und Hosting-Dienstleistungen partnerschaftlich mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Wir bieten Dir eine Perspektive in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen. Uns zeichnen offene Arbeitsstrukturen, Duz-Kultur und flache Hierarchien mit unvergleichlichem Team-Spirit aus. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Job und Spaß vereinbar sind und bieten Dir hierfür das entsprechende Umfeld. Bei ständigem Wachstum sind wir stets auf der Suche nach neuen Teammitgliedern. Werde Teil von IONOS und lass uns gemeinsam wachsen.

Du bist leidenschaftlich an der transformativen Kraft künstlicher Intelligenz interessiert? Wir suchen einen Senior Advisor AI Transformation, der als strategischer und operativer Katalysator für unseren Bereich E-Commerce fungiert. In dieser Rolle wirst Du die KI-Evolution in diesen Bereichen gezielt vorantreiben und die Lücke zwischen hochkarätiger Innovation und praktischer Befähigung schließen. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Teams an der Spitze KI-gestützter Customer Journeys und Bestellstrecken stehen.

Aufgabenbereich

Als Sr. Advisor ist es Deine Mission, unsere operativen Experten zu befähigen. Du agierst als strategischer Berater, technischer Mentor und praktischer Umsetzer – und stellst die Werkzeuge, Prototypen und das Wissen bereit, die unsere Teams benötigen, um Spitzenleistungen zu erbringen. Während die Fachabteilungen die Verantwortung für ihre Ergebnisse behalten, lieferst Du das KI-gestützte „Wie“ zu deren „Was“.

  • Prozesstransformation: Unterstützen Sie unsere Teams bei der Steigerung der Effizienz in den Bereichen Kampagnenidee, -erstellung und -analyse, indem Sie die richtigen KI-Tools identifizieren und in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe integrieren.
  • Sie treiben die KI-Transformation rund um unsere Online-Shops und Vertriebsplattformen voran und nehmen die beteiligten Organisationen dabei mit.
  • Kampagneneffektivität: Beraten Sie bei der Nutzung von KI zur Steigerung der Personalisierung und Effektivität in Kampagnen und Vertriebsinitiativen.
  • Requirements Engineering: Fungieren Sie als Lead für unsere internen Tools, indem Sie klare, hochwertige Geschäftsanforderungen definieren, die von den Entwicklungsteams in unserer Kerninfrastruktur umgesetzt werden.
  • Prototyping & „Vibe Coding“: Packen Sie mit an und erstellen Sie funktionale Prototypen von KI-basierten Prozessen unter Verwendung interner/externer Tools und Natural Language Coding, um Konzepte zu beweisen und Anforderungen zu validieren.

Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der digitalen Transformation, Marketing-Technologie oder Entwicklung, mit einem klaren Fokus auf KI-Implementierung.
  • Hands-on Builder: Sie beraten nicht nur; Sie bauen. Sie fühlen sich sicher im Umgang mit „Vibe Coding“, Rapid Prototyping und dem tiefen Eintauchen in KI-Tools, um zu sehen, was in der Praxis funktioniert.
  • Das „Enabler“-Mindset: Sie sind ein natürlicher Vermittler, der seinen Erfolg darin findet, anderen zum Erfolg zu verhelfen. Sie können komplexe KI-Logik nicht-technischen Kollegen mit Leichtigkeit erklären.
  • Technischer Übersetzer: Sie besitzen die ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, geschäftliche Anforderungen in präzise technische Vorgaben für externe Entwicklungsteams zu übersetzen.
  • Sprache: Fließende Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Deutsch oder andere europäische Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
  • Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.
  • Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
  • Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.
  • Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Über IONOS

IONOS ist der führende europäische Digitalisierungs-Partner für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU). IONOS hat mehr als sechs Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und ist mit einer weltweit verfügbaren Plattform in 18 Märkten in Europa und Nordamerika aktiv. Mit seinen Web Presence & Productivity-Angeboten agiert das Unternehmen als “One-Stop-Shop" für alle Digitalisierungs-Bedürfnisse - von Domains und Webhosting über klassische Website-Builder und Do-It-Yourself-Lösungen, von E-Commerce bis zu Online-Marketing-Tools. Darüber hinaus bietet IONOS Cloud-Lösungen für Firmen, die im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung ihres Geschäfts in die Cloud wechseln möchten.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Content Marketing Manager (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Lumiform
description_html:
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing, Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations and shifts.

We think writing will increasingly be handled by AI. Knowing what to write about will not, and neither will writing something that is actually worth reading. The value moves to the person who can build two kinds of knowledge fast.

First, the topic. What a HACCP verification actually involves in a restaurant chain, why a bakery fails a hygiene audit, what a fleet manager is dealing with when hundreds of vehicles need daily checks across a country. The problems, the standards, the vocabulary, the things that go wrong. Second, the product. What Lumiform actually does, how logic, scoring, offline capture and workflow automation work, and where the product genuinely solves that specific problem versus where it does not. You build both by reading primary sources, watching customer demos and talking to the people in sales and success who hear these problems every day. The content that wins is written where those two meet.

On top of that sits original research. This is our biggest growth bet, and it will be yours to own. Benchmark reports that give this category a reference point it currently does not have, shared with industry bodies and journalists. You come up with the angle, find the data and build something worth citing.

This is a research and expertise role that ends in writing, not a writing role that starts with a prompt. You go deep, get technical, learn faster than seems reasonable, then produce content that reads like a human wrote it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on four priorities.

1. Topic ownership and expertise

  • Own assigned topic areas and content clusters. Within weeks you are the person in the company who knows the most about your topics.
  • Build that knowledge from primary sources, customer demos and conversations with sales and success.
  • Know the product properly and be able to adapt it to specific use cases and competitor comparisons.

2. Benchmark reports and original research

  • Our biggest growth bet. You come up with the ideas, define the angle and decide what is worth measuring.
  • Research internal and external data and build reports at an academic level of rigor that hold up when a journalist or industry body checks them, then work with the marketing managers to get them in front of the right people.

3. Content production

  • Write app use pages that show exactly how Lumiform works for a specific industry use case, from HACCP and fire safety to vehicle inspections.
  • Write listicles, competitor comparison pages and best-alternative pages that position Lumiform clearly against each competitor and around topics.
  • Write customer stories based on real interviews, plus newsletters and other marketing materials.

4. Publishing and maintenance

  • Publish and manage content in WordPress, applying SEO and AEO fundamentals.
  • Improve existing content on quality, relevance, structure and performance.
  • Use actual data from demos and customer calls to turn them into FAQs and on-page answers, so the website handles objections before a prospect asks one of our reps.

Requirements

Required

  • 4+ years in content marketing, meaningful time spent in B2B SaaS
  • A smart mind with a top university degree
  • Native-level English writing. This role produces English content for an international audience and the bar is publication quality.
  • Proven independent research. You have found data, worked with primary sources, judged what is reliable and built something original out of it. Bring examples.
  • You develop expertise fast. Hand you an unfamiliar regulated topic on Monday and you can hold a credible conversation with a practitioner by Friday
  • Technical curiosity. You want to understand how a product actually works and which problems it solves.
  • You are able to use AI properly. It accelerates research and drafting, and the output is never final. You revise, restructure and add what the model cannot, which is judgement, a point of view and a reason the piece exists.
  • You write clearly, creatively and in an approachable, human way. No filler, no throat-clearing, no AI slop.
  • You bring your own ideas. You propose topics and reports rather than waiting for a brief.
  • Reliable, diligent and proactive. You take ownership of your work, meet deadlines and pay close attention to accuracy, quality and consistency.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience building benchmark reports, surveys or other original research content
  • Familiarity with WordPress
  • Basic SEO understanding, including keyword research, keyword integration, headings, internal linking and content optimisation
  • You have already heard of AEO (answer engine optimization) and understand why it matters. It is our biggest growth engine.
  • Experience writing about regulated or technical subjects such as food safety, quality, EHS or logistics

Benefits

About Lumiform

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

Why working with us

  • You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm.
  • Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy. You work closely with two marketing managers and directly with our founders.
  • Own a growth bet from scratch. Benchmark reports will carry your name and go out to industry bodies, journalists and analysts.
  • Go deep on subjects most marketers never touch. You leave here knowing more about inspections, audits and frontline operations than almost anyone in the market.
  • Work fully remote and choose where you get things done

If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough. If you have written something you are proud of, a benchmark report, a deeply researched piece, anything that took real work, send it along.

Our Hiring Process

  • Screening call (30 minutes) with HR
  • First interview (general get to know call) with founder (30 minutes)
  • Second interview (deep dive interview) with founder
  • We ask you for 2 references and will conduct reference calls (as a final step)

title: Technicien Systèmes et Réseaux - Alternance
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Lengow
description_html:
📍 Localisation : Nantes (Île de Nantes)
🕒 Date de prise de poste : janvier 2027
🌍 Langues : français courant (> C1) et anglais professionnel (> B2)
🏡 2 jours de télétravail par semaine

🤓 Lengow, une plateforme e-commerce intelligente et automatisée

Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes qui permettent aux marques et aux retailers de générer une croissance rentable.

Grâce à une suite complète de solutions SaaS combinant gestion de flux produits, gestion des marketplaces, veille tarifaire concurrentielle et monitoring des réseaux de distribution, Lengow permet aux marques et aux retailers d’accroître la visibilité de leurs produits, d’affiner leur stratégie tarifaire, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de mieux piloter leur réseau de distribution.

Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne plus de 3 600 marques et revendeurs dans plus de 70 pays.

Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi évoluer dans un environnement international et multiculturel, au contact d’équipes aux profils variés, réparties notamment entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

À propos de l’équipe IT interne

L’équipe IT interne de Lengow veille au bon fonctionnement et à la sécurité de l’environnement de travail de nos 150 collaborateurs répartis entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

Elle est composée d’un(e) IT Manager, responsable de l’ensemble du périmètre IT interne, accompagné(e) d’un(e) alternant(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux.

Notre environnement couvre notamment le support utilisateurs, la gestion du parc informatique, les systèmes et réseaux, la gestion des comptes et des accès, la sécurité et l’administration de nos outils internes.

L’équipe intervient dans un environnement multi-sites et multi-OS (Windows, macOS et Linux) et travaille à la fois sur les opérations IT du quotidien et sur des projets d’amélioration et de modernisation de notre environnement.

Objectif du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe IT et travailler au quotidien aux côtés de l’IT Manager.

Cette alternance te permettra de développer une expérience concrète et polyvalente de l’IT interne, aux côtés de l’IT Manager. Tu monteras progressivement en compétences sur un périmètre IT varié, avec de plus en plus d’autonomie et de responsabilités, aussi bien sur les opérations du quotidien que sur des projets d’amélioration. 

Tu évolueras dans un environnement international, avec des collaborateurs présents sur plusieurs sites, à accompagner aussi bien sur place qu’à distance.

⌨️ Tes principales missions

Support utilisateurs

  • Assurer le support IT des collaborateurs sur site et à distance
  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents liés aux postes, outils et accès
  • Préparer et accompagner les arrivées et départs des collaborateurs
  • Escalader les problématiques complexes à l’IT Manager lorsque nécessaire

Parc informatique

  • Préparer, configurer et maintenir les équipements utilisateurs
  • Participer au suivi du parc et à la gestion de l’inventaire IT
  • Intervenir sur des environnements Windows, macOS et Linux
  • Participer au renouvellement et au déploiement des équipements

Systèmes, accès & réseaux

  • Participer à l’administration de Google Workspace et Active Directory
  • Contribuer à la gestion des comptes, groupes et droits utilisateurs
  • Participer au maintien et au dépannage du réseau : Wi-Fi, VLAN, switches et connectivité
  • Contribuer au maintien en condition opérationnelle de l’environnement IT

Sécurité & amélioration continue

  • Contribuer au déploiement des mises à jour et outils de sécurité
  • Participer au suivi de la sécurité des postes de travail
  • Contribuer à la documentation des procédures et de l’environnement IT
  • Participer à l’amélioration et à l’automatisation des processus IT
  • Accompagner l’IT Manager sur différents projets d’évolution de l’environnement

Requirements

🏹 Profil recherché

Connaissances :

  • Bases solides en réseau (TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLAN)
  • Connaissances initiales en administration de systèmes Windows et/ou Linux ; une première exposition à Active Directory est appréciée
  • Sensibilisation aux bonnes pratiques de sécurité informatique
  • Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais professionnel (B2 minimum)

Qualités personnelles :

  • Curiosité, rigueur et envie d’apprendre
  • Bon relationnel et sens du service
  • Bonnes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes
  • Esprit d’équipe et capacité à collaborer

Une première expérience en support ou administration systèmes et réseaux est appréciée, mais nous recherchons avant tout une personne avec de bonnes bases techniques et l’envie de progresser sur un périmètre IT varié.

🪜 Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien RH en visio
  • Entretien manager
  • Test technique suivi d’un débrief

Benefits

✨ Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi bénéficier de nombreux avantages :

🏖️ 5 semaines de congés payés
🏡 Horaires flexibles, 2 jours de télétravail par semaine et indemnité télétravail
🍴 Tickets restaurant (EdenRed) : 8 €/jour, pris en charge à 50 % par Lengow
🚲 Indemnité mobilité douce jusqu’à 200 €/an ou remboursement des transports en commun à 50 %
💻 Choix de ton environnement de travail : MacOS, Windows ou Linux
🩺 Mutuelle & prévoyance Malakoff Humanis
🍎 Fruits frais livrés au bureau chaque semaine
🎉 Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour se retrouver et partager des moments ensemble

title: Medical Equipment and Device Service Technician/Engineer (m/f/x) - Berlin, Germany
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Genoray EU GmbH
description_html:
We are looking for a colleague to join Genoray’s German subsidiary in Berlin.

Genoray manufactures medical and dental X-ray equipment. Our products are distributed globally through our headquarters in South Korea, five overseas subsidiaries (Germany, USA, Japan, Türkiye and Shanghai), and more than 40 international partners.

As the European subsidiary, we operate in a B2B model, supplying our products to local distributors across more than 20 countries, including Germany, the UK, Spain and Italy. Our goal is to strengthen our presence in the European market by ensuring high customer satisfaction, making service a key part of our success and of your role with us.

As a Medical Equipment and Device Field Technician/Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting medical (C-arms and mammography systems) and dental (OPG, CBCT, and portable) product lines.

Our work contributes to safer diagnostics and better patient care. We value a collaborative environment where colleagues support and inspire each other.

Tasks

  • Customer Service, Technical Support and Training: Provide technical support to distributors in Europe, including troubleshooting, problem resolution and general assistance for medical equipment. Perform installation, maintenance, repairs and technical inspections. Deliver training to customers and partners on proper equipment use and handling.
  • Business Travel and On-Site Service: Carry out service-related business trips within Europe and internationally, which include installations, repairs, inspections, and other technical service activities.
  • Logistics, Warehouse and Spare Parts Management: Handle goods receipt and dispatch processes, including unloading deliveries, safe storage of equipment, preparation and shipment of devices and parts, as well as coordination with transport providers. Manage spare parts inventory to ensure availability for service and customer needs.
  • Administrative and Service Operations: Prepare necessary sales and shipping documentation (e.g. Proforma Invoice, Commercial Invoice). Perform administrative tasks related to service operations, logistics and spare parts management.
  • Equipment Preparation and Exhibitions: Inspect, adapt and configure machines for shipment according to customer requirements, including technical adjustments where needed. Support installation and deinstallation of equipment at exhibitions and trade fairs.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering, or a comparable degree or relevant practical experience
  • Professional experience is not required, but considered an advantage
  • Experience in customer service or technical support for medical equipment is preferred
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-organized with a structured and solution-oriented mindset
  • Fluent English is required; German and/or Korean language skills are considered an advantage
  • Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis with no travel restrictions
  • Valid work permit for Germany required

Benefits

  • Being part of a globally leading and fast-growing medical and dental X-ray equipment manufacturing company
  • Company laptop and mobile phone provided
  • Exciting international working environment with partners across the globe
  • Flat organizational structure that encourages open communication and the contribution of your ideas
  • 27 vacation days plus public holidays
  • Free coffee, tea, snacks, and other refreshments
  • Office located in the heart of Berlin

description_html:
Commercial(e) terrain indépendant(e) – SumUp

Vous avez une réelle expérience de la prospection à froid, sur le terrain ou par téléphone ? Rejoignez SumUp et accompagnez les commerçants avec des solutions de paiement simples et reconnues.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter les cafés, restaurants, boutiques, salons et entreprises de votre secteur ;
  • Identifier leurs besoins, présenter la solution adaptée et réaliser des démonstrations ;
  • Accompagner les commerçants jusqu'à l'activation et développer votre portefeuille.

La prospection est réalisée par vos soins : aucun portefeuille de leads n'est fourni.

Votre rémunération

Cette activité est rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire fixe ni plafond :

  • 50 % de commission immédiate sur le matériel, les logiciels et les paiements générés par le commerçant au cours de son premier mois ;
  • 20 % de revenus récurrents sur l'activité de chaque commerçant signé, versés mensuellement pendant une durée pouvant aller jusqu'à 24 mois.

Exemple : un commerçant actif générant environ 15 000 € de volume de paiement mensuel peut vous permettre de percevoir plus de 1 000 € de commissions cumulées sur 24 mois.Ce montant indicatif varie selon les produits vendus, l'activation, le volume réel et le maintien de l'activité du commerçant. Aucun revenu minimum n'est garanti.

Vos outils et votre organisation

SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner.

Votre zone est définie pendant le recrutement selon votre localisation et les secteurs ouverts. Vous organisez librement votre activité. Vos déplacements et les frais associés restent à votre charge ; aucun véhicule de fonction n'est fourni.

Votre profil

  • Au moins un an d'expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ;
  • À l'aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ;
  • Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ;
  • Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ;
  • Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ;
  2. Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ;
  3. Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation.

Envie de développer votre activité avec une rémunération sans plafond et des revenus récurrents potentiels ? Postulez dès maintenant !

 

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Country Manager - Software Unternehmen - Private Equity (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Options Group
description_html:
Wir unterstützen ein von Private Equity finanziertes Softwareunternehmen im Gesundheitswesen bei der Besetzung der Position eines Country Managers (m/w/d) und künftigen CEO (m/w/d), der das Unternehmen zu einem Exit führen soll.

Nach einer kürzlich getätigten Investition steht das Unternehmen vor einer wichtigen Phase des Wachstums, der Professionalisierung und der Produktentwicklung. Derzeit erwirtschaftet es einen Umsatz von weniger als 3 Millionen Euro, ist jedoch hochprofitabel.

Aufgaben

Der künftige Country Manager wird die Gesamtverantwortung für das Unternehmen übernehmen und eng mit dem bestehenden Team, dem Gründer und den Gesellschaftern zusammenarbeiten, um die Leistung zu steigern, die Softwareplattform weiterzuentwickeln und das Unternehmen innerhalb von etwa 18 Monaten auf einen möglichen Exit vorzubereiten.

Die Besetzung dieser Position ist Teil einer geplanten Führungsnachfolge. Der Gründer und derzeitige CEO wird während einer anfänglichen Übergangsphase eng mit dem neuen Country Manager zusammenarbeiten und ihm sein Wissen über das Geschäft, den Markt und wichtige Kundenbeziehungen zur Verfügung stellen.

Die Übergangsphase wird voraussichtlich etwa 6 bis 9 Monate dauern, wobei die Übergabe je nachdem, wie schnell sich der neue Country Manager einarbeiten und Verantwortung übernehmen kann, auch früher erfolgen könnte.

Zu den Aufgaben gehören:

  • Übernahme der vollen Verantwortung für die P&L sowie Erreichen der Wachstums- und Rentabilitätsziele
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem bestehenden Team zur Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung der Softwareplattform auf Basis von Kundenfeedback und sich wandelnden Marktanforderungen
  • Vorantreiben der Implementierung von KI-Funktionen sowie Identifizierung praktischer Anwendungsfälle, die die Plattform verbessern, das Kundenerlebnis steigern und die Effizienz erhöhen
  • Umsetzung von Kundenbedürfnissen und Markterkenntnissen in klare Produktprioritäten und Entwicklungsinitiativen
  • Ein kleines, hochspezialisiertes Team leiten, motivieren und weiterentwickeln
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Private-Equity-Gesellschafter und dem Vorstand bei der Umsetzung des Value Creation Plans
  • Vorbereitung des Unternehmens auf einen möglichen Exit

Qualifikation

Der ideale Kandidat bringt Folgendes mit:

  • Führungserfahrung in einem B2B-Softwareunternehmen
  • Vorherige P&L responsibility, idealerweise als Country Manager, Geschäftsführer, General Manager, CEO oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsposition
  • Ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für Softwareprodukte und Geschäftsmodelle
  • Interesse an KI und deren praktischer Anwendung in Softwareprodukten und Geschäftsprozessen
  • Eine kundenorientierte Denkweise und Erfahrung darin, Kundenfeedback in Produktverbesserungen umzusetzen
  • Die Fähigkeit, strategisches Denken mit einer sehr praxisorientierten und pragmatischen Herangehensweise zu verbinden
  • Flüssige Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse sind unerlässlich, gepaart mit ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Umgang mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern, Gesellschaftern und anderen Stakeholdern

Benefits

  • Möglichkeit remote zu arbeiten - Reisebereitschaft vorausgesetzt
  • Wichtige Standorte sind der Großraum München sowie die Schweiz
  • Signifikanter Exit-Bonus
  • Möglichkeit zum CEO aufzusteigen sowie Einstieg in das Private Equity Geschäft

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbungen!

title: Mitarbeiter Datenmanagement & KI (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Finanz Protect GmbH
description_html:
Sie verstehen Daten, denken in Prozessen und haben Freude daran, digitale Abläufe zu verbessern? Dann gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Versicherungsverwaltung.

Die Finanz Protect GmbH ist ein Finanz- und Versicherungsmakler mit Sitz am Phoenixsee in Dortmund und betreut Kunden bundesweit. Wir wachsen und suchen Unterstützung für unser Daten- und Schnittstellenmanagement sowie für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Automatisierungs- und KI-Prozesse.

Bei uns sorgen Sie dafür, dass Kunden- und Vertragsdaten zuverlässig verarbeitet werden, Systeme miteinander kommunizieren und aus manuellen Arbeitsschritten effiziente digitale Abläufe werden. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserem Team und externen Softwarepartnern zusammen.

Aufgaben

  • Datenmanagement und Datenqualität: Sie pflegen und strukturieren Kunden- und Vertragsdaten in unserem Maklerverwaltungsprogramm, erkennen Dubletten und Unstimmigkeiten und sorgen für eine verlässliche Datenbasis.
  • BiPRO-Abruf: Sie richten digitale Abrufe von Versicherungsdokumenten und Daten ein, überwachen deren Verarbeitung und stellen die korrekte Zuordnung zu Kunden und Verträgen sicher.
  • GDV-Datenverarbeitung: Sie importieren und verarbeiten GDV-Bestandsdaten, gleichen diese mit vorhandenen Datensätzen ab und klären fehlerhafte oder unvollständige Übertragungen.
  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Sie betreuen die Anbindungen zwischen Maklerverwaltungsprogramm, Versicherern, Maklerpools und weiteren Anwendungen. Bei Störungen koordinieren Sie die Fehleranalyse und Behebung mit den jeweiligen Ansprechpartnern.
  • Bestandsintegration: Sie unterstützen die Übernahme zugekaufter Versicherungsbestände durch die Aufbereitung, Übertragung und Qualitätskontrolle der Kunden- und Vertragsdaten.
  • Automatisierung: Sie identifizieren wiederkehrende manuelle Aufgaben und entwickeln automatisierte Abläufe, beispielsweise für Dokumentenzuordnung, Datenpflege und interne Bearbeitungsprozesse.
  • KI- Prozesse: Sie erproben und integrieren KI-Anwendungen für die Dokumentenerkennung, Informationsextraktion und Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft. Dabei prüfen Sie die Ergebnisse auf Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Dokumentation und Wissenstransfer: Sie dokumentieren Abläufe verständlich und unterstützen das Team bei der sicheren Anwendung neuer digitaler Prozesse.

Qualifikation

Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Versicherungsbereich, in der IT oder im kaufmännischen Bereich mit ausgeprägtem technischem Schwerpunkt – oder über vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung.

Sie bringen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Versicherungsdaten, Maklerverwaltungsprogrammen oder digitalen Verwaltungsprozessen mit.

Kenntnisse in BiPRO, GDV-Datenverarbeitung und Schnittstellenmanagement sind besonders willkommen. In einzelne Themen können Sie sich bei entsprechender Vorerfahrung und Lernbereitschaft einarbeiten.

Sie arbeiten sicher mit Excel und können Daten strukturiert aufbereiten, abgleichen und auf Fehler prüfen.

Sie haben praktische Erfahrung mit Automatisierungswerkzeugen wie Make oder Power Automate beziehungsweise großes Interesse, sich darin zu vertiefen.

Sie nutzen KI-Anwendungen praxisorientiert und können beurteilen, an welchen Stellen diese sinnvoll eingesetzt werden und wo eine menschliche Prüfung erforderlich bleibt.

Kenntnisse in APIs, Datenformaten wie CSV, XML oder JSON sowie grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Sie arbeiten sorgfältig, analytisch und eigenverantwortlich. Auch bei komplexen Datenbeständen behalten Sie den Überblick und gehen Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund.

Sie gehen verantwortungsbewusst mit sensiblen Kunden- und Vertragsdaten um und können technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln.

Benefits

Unsere Benefits für Mitarbeiter/innen:

  • Eine Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf unsere digitale Weiterentwicklung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien
  • Modernes Büro im RIVA-Gebäude am Phoenixsee in Dortmund
  • Moderne Software, KI-Anwendungen und technische Ausstattung
  • Monatliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Flexibles Gleitzeitmodell
  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen für eigene Versicherungen und Depots
  • Betriebliche Altersversorgung mit Zuschuss
  • Über 300 Gesundheitsleistungen, darunter Physiotherapie, Zahnreinigung, Brillenzuschüsse und Massagen
  • Premium-Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft inklusive Sauna
  • Höhenverstellbare Schreibtische und ergonomische Bürostühle
  • Kostenfreie Getränke wie Wasser, Kaffee und Softdrinks

Bei der Finanz Protect GmbH legen wir großen Wert auf das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeiter. Wir bieten Ihnen nicht nur spannende Aufgaben und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, sondern auch attraktive Benefits, um Ihnen den Arbeitsalltag angenehm zu gestalten.

Sie möchten Daten nicht nur verwalten, sondern dafür sorgen, dass Prozesse besser funktionieren? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.

Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf und erzählen Sie uns kurz, mit welchen Systemen, Schnittstellen oder Automatisierungen Sie bereits gearbeitet haben. Geben Sie bitte auch Ihren möglichen Eintrittstermin, Ihren gewünschten Stundenumfang und Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung an.
